_comment: Split for every transcript in the corpus, assigned BEFORE labelling and never moved. examples: the extraction prompt's worked examples come from these, so they are never scored. dev: iterate freely. test: held out, scored for promotion. fresh: published after the executor's training cutoff. The two test transcripts each supply one extract-v3 example; that passage is masked in evals/labels/<id>.json and never scored. Do not draw new prompt examples from dev/test/fresh transcripts.
